title: Standardized Immunohistochemical Staining for Human Protein Atlas
author: Anna Martinez Casals
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yjjfukn
materials: Dehydrate slides in graded ethanol and Neo-Clear.

steps.title: Dry and Bake Sections
steps.instruction: Prepare paraffin sections by drying and baking them.

substeps.instruction: Dry paraffin sections at room temperature overnight.
Bake the paraffin sections from 12:00:00 to 24:00:00 at 50 °C.

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Hydrate
steps.instruction: Perform deparaffinization and hydration using xylene and graded ethanol to distilled water.

steps.title: Block Endogenous Peroxidase
steps.instruction: Block endogenous peroxidase during the hydration step.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 00:05:00 in 3% volume H2O2 in 95% ethanol.

steps.title: Antigen Retrieval
steps.instruction: Perform heat-induced epitope retrieval using a pressure boiler.

substeps.instruction: Heat slides immersed in retrieval buffer for 00:04:00 at 125 °C in a pressure boiler.
After boiling, leave slides in the pressure boiler to cool down to 90 °C (total time 00:45:00).

steps.title: Blocking and Primary Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Process slides using the Autostainer 480 (ThermoFisher Scientific, cat# A80500007) at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Incubate slides with Ultra V Block for 00:05:00.
Incubate slides with primary antibody diluted in antibody diluent for 00:30:00.

steps.title: Detection and Visualization
steps.instruction: Apply HRP polymer and DAB solution using the Autostainer 480 at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Incubate slides with labeled HRP polymer for 00:30:00.
Incubate slides with DAB solution for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Final Rinsing and Mounting
steps.instruction: Complete the process using the Autostainer XL (Leica biosystems, cat# Leica ST5010 Autostainer XL).

substeps.instruction: Rinse slides in lithium carbonate water (diluted 1:5 from saturated solution) for 00:01:00.
Rinse slides in tap water for 00:05:00.
Mount a coverslip on each slide.
